title: Draw a diagram at a glance
caption: A picture is data: you write what it holds, the tool places everything, and a test keeps the two equal.

cards.title: The diagrams tool
cards.text: Draws every diagrams/*.json under the docs into its SVG.

cards.title: The JSON
cards.text: Its kind, title, caption and what it holds.

cards.title: The SVG
cards.text: Drawn by the tool, never edited by hand.

cards.title: The link
cards.text: A markdown image in the doc, with its alt text.

cards.title: The test
cards.text: Fails on a stale or unlinked picture.

cards.title: Seven kinds
cards.text: cards, flow, sequence, classes, nested, composite and ticket.
